# zlib-ng / fuzzer_example_large

zlib-ng's own fuzz target `fuzzer_example_large` ([source](source/fuzzer_example_large.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over zlib-ng (zlib-ng/zlib-ng at 1579085c).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an invariant: Deflate a zero buffer, then the already-compressed bytes at level 0, then the zero buffer at level 9/Z_FILTERED; inflate total_out must equal exactly 2*uncomprLen + diff. Output length only, content not compared.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zlib-ng at commit 1579085c.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- deflate must be greedy (avail_in == 0 after the first call), Z_FINISH must return Z_STREAM_END, every other call Z_OK ([lines 43-71](source/fuzzer_example_large.c#L43-L71)): exit(1); not confirmed in the binary.
- Deflate a zero buffer, then the already-compressed bytes at level 0, then the zero buffer at level 9/Z_FILTERED; inflate total_out must equal exactly 2*uncomprLen + diff. Output length only, content not compared ([lines 103-106](source/fuzzer_example_large.c#L103-L106)): exit(1); confirmed in the binary.

A failure of the check at lines 103-106 ends the process with a status that the halts statements below that name it exclude, so a proof of one of those statements implies it on every input it covers. No statement here proves the other check.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch zlib-ng` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzzer_example_large.plain` | 155,696 | `242dbd8e67e7ecf5cc40611ca3c3194651f1a96267fe7016b2e298d00c6101c9` |
| ubsan | `fuzzer_example_large.ubsan` | 153,344 | `6611111e99ff653522047d55cf4c3a941f247058c789805723343329ba2f2ccf` |
| asan | `fuzzer_example_large.asan` | 822,936 | `cb98d791af2ad23e85e2792ec98dc76d451c50c9532922280289480d40cb692d` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzzer_example_large.asan-ubsan` | 799,064 | `ceb88e36ca43e167501f6d9ae3fae3fce77b08844668104e456dc34681c160d1` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
